messages:
ellie: mid-afternoon detour  behold: my dog Peanut teaching the neighborhood squirrel to fetch a tiny acorn. video: https://imgur.com/a/PeanutSquirrel :laughing:
zane: wait that squirrel actually brings it back?? :astonished:
tom: this is a 2026 patent for interspecies hustle :money_with_wings: :joy:
ivy: i watched the loop 6 times. peanut does a very specific head tilt at 0:08 like a tiny professor. :nerd_face:
ellie: sequence: 1) peanut drops acorn, 2) squirrel grabs it, 3) squirrel returns, 4) peanut performs a ceremonial paw tap. very civilized. :paw_prints:
peanut-bot: Automated pet reminder: share vet records for office visits and register at https://redwood.example.com/pets before bringing Peanut to campus. :information_source:
zane: question: are we allowed to bring squirrels as service animals? half-serious :sweat_smile:
tom: only if they have completed "Fetch 101" training with certificate :scroll:
ivy: can we have a poll: Team name for the duo? react :one: "Peanut & The Fetching Bandit", :two: "Acorn Partners", :three: "The Paw and The Rodent"
(reactions: zane :two:, tom :one:)
ellie: uploaded still: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T55555-F66666/peanut_squirrel_still.jpg
zane: :two: for peak branding, honestly :ok_hand:
tom: :one: because theatricality is key :top_hat:
peanut-bot: Poll results: "Peanut & The Fetching Bandit" 1, "Acorn Partners" 1, "The Paw and The Rodent" 0
ivy: can we schedule a "Bring Your Quirky Duo" micro-showcase next Friday? i volunteer to moderate and maybe bring cookies. :cookie:
ellie: yes! i'll sign up Peanut. note: the squirrel is strictly neighborhood-licensed and remains outdoors. no surprise guests indoors pls :wave:
zane: also, who wants to be on dog-walking rotation this weekend? inbox me if free. :walking:
